A first stop before [Classic Drum Machines Compared](drum-compare.qmd). Short sections, one idea each. Click a heading to fold or open it.

::: {.ik-do}
**What you'll do**

1. Read what the LinnDrum is and when it was made.
2. Learn its sound, one idea at a time.
3. Take a guided tour: press each **▶ Hear step** button and listen for one change.
4. Find records it is on.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- The **LinnDrum** was made by **Linn Electronics**, designed by the American engineer **Roger Linn**, between **1982 and 1985** (Wikipedia, "LinnDrum").
- Its sounds are **recordings of real drums**, stored in chips (Wikipedia).
- It "sold far more units than the Linn LM-1 and its successor, the Linn 9000, combined" (Wikipedia).

## Its sound

- Some drums have **levels**: snare 3, and bass, hi-hat and others 2 (LinnDrum manual, p. 1).
- Only snare, sidestick, toms and congas can be **tuned**; "all other drums are not tunable" (manual, p. 1).
- **Timing A to F** adds swing: A is straight and E a perfect triplet shuffle (manual, pp. 8-9).
- On this page the sounds are stand-ins made to sound like 8-bit samples; they are not the real recordings.

## Guided tour

Each step plays two bars. Numbers in a step are the LinnDrum's levels.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:104,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;2.....2.2.......&quot;,&quot;snare&quot;:&quot;....2.......2...&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.&quot;}}"><p><b>A pop beat.</b> Bass, snare and 8th-note hi-hats, all at one level. Listen: real drum sounds, steady.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:104,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;2.....2.2.......&quot;,&quot;snare&quot;:&quot;....3..1....3...&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;2.1.2.1.2.1.2.1.&quot;}}"><p><b>Levels.</b> Loud and soft hi-hats, and a quiet snare between. Listen: more human.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:104,&quot;timing&quot;:&quot;D&quot;,&quot;swingGrid&quot;:8,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;2.....2.2.......&quot;,&quot;snare&quot;:&quot;....3..1....3...&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;2.1.2.1.2.1.2.1.&quot;}}"><p><b>Timing D.</b> Swing on the 8ths. Listen: it bounces.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:104,&quot;timing&quot;:&quot;E&quot;,&quot;swingGrid&quot;:8,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;2.....2.2.......&quot;,&quot;snare&quot;:&quot;....3..1....3...&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;2.1.2.1.2.1.2.1.&quot;}}"><p><b>Timing E.</b> The perfect triplet shuffle (manual p. 9). Listen: a full shuffle. The manual says many people prefer C or D.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:104,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;2.....2.2.......&quot;,&quot;snare&quot;:&quot;....3.......3...&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.&quot;},&quot;kit&quot;:{&quot;snare&quot;:{&quot;tune&quot;:2}}}"><p><b>Tune the snare down.</b> Snare <b>Tune</b> low. Listen: a deeper, fatter snare.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:104,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;2.....2.2.......&quot;,&quot;snare&quot;:&quot;....3.......3...&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.&quot;,&quot;tamb&quot;:&quot;....2.......2...&quot;,&quot;clap&quot;:&quot;....1.......1...&quot;}}"><p><b>Tambourine and claps.</b> Listen: the 1980s pop sound.</p></div>
```

## Famous records

Named in Wikipedia, "LinnDrum":

- used by Trevor Horn, Mark Knopfler, George Michael and Naked Eyes
